summary: Inspected all 28 files in the review unit. Four files (Iris/Iris/Algebra/Lib.lean, Iris/Iris/BI.lean, Iris/Iris/Instances/Lib.lean, Iris/Iris/ProofMode.lean) are pure import aggregators containing only `public import` statements — FILTER-007 candidates. The other 24 files contain substantial Iris-specific formal mathematics: algebraic structures (CMRAs, time receipts, numbers), BI infrastructure (base classes, derived laws, later credits, monotone predicates, updates), HeapLang program logic (primitive/derived laws, ticket lock), IProp model instances (FUpd, later credits, time receipts), program logic (adequacy, lifting, weakest preconditions), proof mode instances, and test files with executable content (#guard_msgs, tactic regressions). Per FILTER-007 and prior review RRV-74dfa75dd55e-r2, import aggregators are not hard-excludable without a verified deployed navigation/auxiliary query pipeline. All files retain genuine searchable formal mathematics; no exclusions warranted.
